meta.title: Whole range sits between the two thresholds

payload.requisition_text:
Graduate Software Engineer (two openings)
Elvermere Systems Ltd — Cambridge

Elvermere builds laboratory-information systems used by NHS pathology networks. Correctness here is not a slogan: our software carries results that clinicians act on.

The graduate scheme pairs you with a senior for six months in either the LIMS core team (Java) or the integrations team (HL7, C#). Expect real code review and a lot of it.

We ask for a 2:1 in a STEM subject or equivalent project evidence, and we sponsor Skilled Worker visas for these positions.

Banding for graduate entry is £35,000-£37,500. Cambridge station office, 3 days on site. Assessment day format, one round.

expected.determining_fact: The whole advertised band (£35,000-£37,500) clears the general threshold but stays below the £38,300 going rate, so no offer within the band can be sponsored.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: we sponsor Skilled Worker visas for these positions

design_notes: Range variant of case-11: definitive fail because even the band maximum is under the going rate. Range minimum keeps 1,600 of margin over the assumed general threshold, so a correction there does not flip the label.
